elements.label: Headline 'and every' scrolling down into centre
Vertical grid lines scrolling and fading out

pattern.description: Continuing the downward scroll from the previous beat, the next phrase 'and every' enters from the top of the frame and decelerates into the centre while the faint vertical grid lines travel with it and fade away.
pattern.why_premium: The exit of one phrase and the entry of the next share a single scroll direction and speed, so the list of 'Every ...' statements reads as one continuous document; the deceleration into centre gives each phrase a clear landing.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.phrase', {y: -360}, {y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out'}).to('.grid', {y: 200, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<') inside an overflow-hidden viewport shared with the previous phrase.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 140, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [-360, 0]); grid opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}).

notes: camera.move is 'none' with pan_y 0.48: content scroll, not a camera tilt. Treated as the entry half of the scroll that began in e011. Spectrogram shows a rising series of soft ticks across the event, but no SFX candidates were given, so none are reviewed.
